summary: Huntington Bancshares filed a routine Form 8-K on September 18, 2026, announcing that its board declared and set aside a quarterly cash dividend on its 5.70% Series I Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock (Nasdaq: HBANM). The dividend is $356.25 per preferred share, equivalent to $0.35625 per depositary share, payable December 1, 2026, to holders of record November 15, 2026. The filing includes the press release as Exhibit 99.1 and is signed by General Counsel Marcy C. Hingst. This is an ordinary preferred dividend declaration, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisor, or transaction mechanics apply.
